the crosstalk between OTSCC cells, EVs, and immune cells is complex.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the immune cells can inhibit the growth of OTSCC cell line and the EVs from OTSCC cell can modulate immune cells activity.
the EVs secreted by cancer cell lines have the potential to modulate the immune cell response and the tumor microenvironment.
the EVs from OTSCC cell line, which has low invasion ability, can activate immune cells and increase their cytotoxicity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EVs secreted by OTSCC cell cultures can affect the activity of immune cells and that the effects are dependent on the cell type and EV source.
the effects of EV-mediated communication on immune cells are cell type-specific and that the effects of immune cell-mediated communication on cancer cells are dependent on the 3D microenvironment.
EVs from cancer cells can influence the immune system, and this influence depends on the cancer cell type and the immune cell type.
